files.installs/bedrock/realmcradle-test-run.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# realmcradle-managed Minecraft Bedrock server — generated by provision().
# This server's own files: <ROOT>/installs/bedrock/realmcradle-servers/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=.
CONSOLE="<ROOT>/installs/bedrock/realmcradle-servers/test/server.log.console"
: > "$CONSOLE"
# The server's console is fed from the file above, so the dashboard can type
# commands into it.
cd "<ROOT>/installs/bedrock/realmcradle-servers/test" || exit 1
exec ./bedrock_server \
    > "<ROOT>/installs/bedrock/realmcradle-servers/test/server.log" 2>&1 < <(tail -n0 -F "$CONSOLE")
files.installs/bedrock/realmcradle-test-stop.s:
#!/bin/sh
# realmcradle-managed graceful stop: ask the server to save and quit, then wait.
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
echo "stop" >> "<ROOT>/installs/bedrock/realmcradle-servers/test/server.log.console"
i=0
while [ $i -lt 45 ] && ! grep -q "Quit correctly" "<ROOT>/installs/bedrock/realmcradle-servers/test/server.log" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done
exit 0
